purpose: one shared reconstruction foundation for head-turn states, not a replacement scene or an 81-background batch

protected: all black-mask pixels, camera/crop, sunset/lighting and major geography; restore exact input pixels outside the mask after generation if necessary

Do not put any animal, animal-shaped object, new prop, symbol, text or watermark into the cleared area. Do not move, zoom, redraw or relight the whole setting. Do not include the red mask-overlay visualization in the output. Return one full-frame RGB clean-plate candidate, no transparency. The output remains an unselected operator asset pending technical review.
postprocess: deterministic restoration of all pixels outside allowed mask; preserve raw provider result and operation receipt
acceptance: no mouse/tail/shadow residue or new animal
plausible continuous path/boulder/foliage reconstruction at native/fitted size
zero protected-pixel differences after bounded restoration
exact output review before dependent turn compositions
if output canvas/projection differs, stop for explicit disposition rather than silently stretching/reframing
stop: failed reconstruction stops dependent work; zero automatic retries; new bytes are not selected automatically
mask_review: Native overlay inspected; includes felt edge fringe, whisker fans, tail and local contact shadow. Conservative erasure neighborhood only; this is a reconstruction mask, not an actor extraction.
